1879060551.Skill_Desc: Costs 30% of your current power but greatly restores your morale.

1879064391.Skill_Desc: Allows you to track the presence of the dead, the unseen, and ancient evil.

1879085127.Skill_Desc: Auto-attack when wielding a two-handed weapon.

1879101511.Skill_Desc: Return quickly to your kinship's house. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879104839.Skill_Desc: Spores weave their way into the target, helping to speed the healing process.

1879113159.Skill_Desc: Gain access to personal manoeuvres, replicating some of the coordination of a mighty fellowship.

1879130695.Skill_Desc: A close-ranged attack that dazes foes around the target.

1879138631.Skill_Desc: A gourd filled with sticky mud is launched at your opponent.

1879160007.Skill_Desc: A horse from the Summer Festival.
1879160007.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available during the Farmer's Faire Festival for Mithril Coins. Also available from the 'Pick a Mount' package.

1879212103.Skill_Desc: This is probably the best snowball that has ever been made. Just the right weight. Just the right amount of moisture. Just the right number of ice shards to really take down your victim.

1879213895.Skill_Desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879230023.Skill_Desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Men of Dunland, you're able to quickly return to Galtrev in Dunland. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879233607.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available in the Anniversary Festival for Mithril Coins.

1879242311.Skill_Desc:
Using your knowledge of fire and all that burns, you heave handfuls of pitch soaked embers at your target. They burn hotter and hotter over time.

When your companion has Flanked the enemy, this skill will deal additional damage. <rgb=#FF7700>

The effects from this skill can stack up to 3 times.</rgb>

1879244871.Skill_Desc: You issue a loud cry drawing the heart out of the enemy, dealing damage and slightly increasing threat against the target.\n\n<rgb=#66ffff>Applies the Shout effect to you. Skill of the Eorlingas becomes Halt the Charge.</rgb>

1879245639.Skill_Desc: A strength that all Rune-keepers possess is the ability to speak well on any subject. This proves to be a great benefit in the midst of a heated debate, and this benefit can prove very potent and effective.

1879250759.Skill_Desc: The Lore-master marks an enemy and allows his allies and their mounts to draw inspiration from fighting the marked foe.

1879255495.Skill_Desc: You focus your energies and etchings toward supporting you and your allies finding inspiration in the verses.

1879271239.Skill_Desc: Deals AoE damage in front of the Champion.\n\nDamage is increased by 30% per pip consumed.

1879271751.Skill_Desc: Shout out to dishearten and impede advancing enemies.

1879295431.Skill_Desc: A tripwire trap can knock a monster down, sometimes creating the opportunity to use a Fellowship Manoeuvre.\n\nTrap remains for 1 minute after being placed.

1879302599.Skill_Desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.
1879302599.Skill_Name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Footsoldier)

1879313735.Skill_Desc: Powerful attack that hits multiple enemies in front of you and cannot be blocked, parried, or evaded. This skill requires a parry event.

1879316039.Skill_Desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Riddermark</rgb>

The Riddermark Discipline turns your focus to steering the course of battle while maintaining your ability to protect allies from enemy assault.

1879316167.Skill_Desc: Summons a frog to keep you company.
1879316167.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available for barter in Eastern Gondor.

1879316295.Skill_Desc: Knocks an enemy down for a short duration from range.

1879368647.Skill_Desc: Brings out a blue peahen to keep you company.
1879368647.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Farmers Faire Festival.

1879385159.Skill_Desc: Brings out a snowy barn owl to keep you company.
1879385159.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Yule Festival.

1879447367.Skill_Desc: Brings out a shimmering beetle to keep you company.
1879447367.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available through barter during the Anniversary Festival.

1879451335.Skill_Desc: You bring out the corrupt nature of your ally's flesh, improving their defences.

1879452871.Skill_Desc: Boosts Tactical damage and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879461703.Skill_Desc: You're able to quickly return to Clegur in Swanfleet. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879461959.Collection_Piece_SourceDesc: Available from completing Angmar Reborn: Deeds of Carn Dûm Resurgent.

1879483335.Skill_Desc: Weaken enemy defences, increasing damage taken from attacks.

1879486023.Skill_Desc: You enlist an Archer to assist you in battle.

1879491527.Skill_Desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Ub Nishir, near Maurûsh in Urash Dâr in the Ikorbân Valley.

1879522375.Skill_Desc: Deals Light damage to nearby foes, and draws threat from nearby fellows to yourself.\n\nThis skill is more potent when used with a Defeat Event.

1879526599.Skill_Desc: Adherents of Balefire have learned to harness power as their enemy burns.

1879528263.Skill_Desc: Send a shadowy spike at your target, dealing damage and reducing their tactical prowess.
